music_prompt: Calm minimal electronic background for a software product demo. Soft warm synth pads, gentle plucked arpeggio, light airy percussion, steady 100 BPM, modern and clean, no vocals, no big drops, even energy throughout, ends softly.

lines.text: Meet Snap. Free and open source.
Snap sees every element under your cursor.
Scroll to go a level up, or down.
Hold Control, and mark it up right there.
Video too. Up to a hundred and twenty frames per second.
And one click turns it into a GIF.
